description:
The features this mod provided are now in vanilla.
As such, it is no longer being maintained.
Have you ever posted "which mod is this ship from?" Well, have I got the mod for you!
WhichMod

This mod adds the mod title to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods.

Example:

Also has the option to use abbreviations instead of the full mod name, and will let you choose the abbreviations. Look in the settings file for more information.

discordPostHtml:
Tells you what mod something is from. Has several options to enable it for hullmods or to use abbreviations instead of the full mod name.

Note that due to coding limitations, ship skins from different mods will be labeled with the mod that the hull is from. For example, if Mod A adds a skin of a ship from Mod B, WhichMod will label it as from Mod B. If the base hull is from vanilla, WhichMod will not label it.

Direct Download: https://github.com/theDragn/whichmod/releases/download/1.2.2/WhichMod_v1.2.2a.zip
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=22367.0
aiDescription: Adds the originating mod's name to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods. It also offers an option to use custom abbreviations instead of the full mod name, which can be configured in the settings file.
